# Notices

The OcuClaw plugin ships the Silent input word tables, built from openly licensed data.

Word data: Google Books Ngram (CC BY 3.0), word lists by hackerb9/gwordlist (CC BY 3.0), Mozilla Common Voice sentences (CC0), Tatoeba sentences (CC BY 2.0 FR, tatoeba.org), Taskmaster dialogs by Google (CC BY 4.0), OpenAssistant oasst1 conversations (Apache 2.0), AMI Meeting Corpus transcripts (CC BY 4.0), AAC communications and language model by Keith Vertanen and Per Ola Kristensson (CC BY 4.0, aactext.org).

Only counts are taken from the sentence sources: no sentence text ships. The full provenance,
with source pins and hashes, is in `BASE-DICTIONARY-PROVENANCE.md` in the OcuClaw repository
(`composeApp/src/webMain/kotlin/com/akelu/ocuclaw/silentinput/`).
